outcomes.outcome: on Ubuntu the key is deployed to /etc/ssl/private/<prefix>.key, 0600, and it is the key of the deployed certificate
the bundle /etc/ssl/certs/<prefix>.nginx.bundle.crt is the certificate then its intermediate
nginx serves TLS with the pair, sending the certificate and its intermediate
nginx is restarted once when the key or certificate changes
on RedHat (ssl_base's CentOS/RHEL branch) the key goes to /etc/pki/tls/private

uncovered.why: the RedHat branch; this set runs on the plan's Ubuntu node
